meta.label: Admin Toolkit Agents
meta.description: AI-native field ops on the Dataiku agentic framework: agent tools + agents over the Admin Toolkit's fleet-aware sensor APIs (health, adoption, cost, config) and gated admin actions.
meta.author: Alex Kaos

params.name: backend_url
params.label: Backend base URL
params.description: Admin Toolkit webapp backend base, e.g. https://dss.example.com/web-apps-backends/PROJECT/webappId — leave empty to auto-discover the webapp on the local DSS.

params.name: red_actions_password
params.label: Advanced Actions password
params.description: Plaintext Advanced Actions password (used to unlock red endpoints headlessly). Leave empty to keep all mutating actions permanently locked.

params.name: host_keys_password
params.label: Remote host keys password
params.description: Password for encrypted remote-host API keys (adkfk1$ blobs). Leave empty if no remote host uses an encrypted key.

params.name: host_allowlist
params.label: Host allowlist
params.description: Comma-separated host ids agents may target (from the toolkit's host list). Empty = all configured hosts.

params.name: heavy_timeout_s
params.label: Heavy-scan timeout (s)
params.description: Timeout for heavy scan endpoints (code envs, project footprint, CRU). On timeout, tools report scan_running with re-invoke advice.

params.name: default_llm_id
params.label: Default LLM id
params.description: LLM Mesh id used by the plugin agents unless overridden per agent (e.g. anthropic:kaosclaude:claude-opus-4-8).

params.name: enable_red_actions
params.label: Enable red actions
params.description: Master kill-switch. OFF = execute-admin-action always refuses, regardless of per-agent settings.

params.name: triage_connection
params.label: Triage PostgreSQL connection
params.description: Postgres connection where daily triage results persist (same connection the toolkit's Story uses). Empty disables the triage loop.

params.name: triage_score_threshold
params.label: Triage score threshold
params.description: Hosts scoring below this get an LLM-drafted recommendation in the daily sweep.
